svg.title: Fourier decomposition of a complex waveform
svg.desc: Annotated visualization showing a complex waveform, its seven harmonic sine components, phase spectrum, magnitude spectrum, and Fourier series formula with animated oscillations.
svg.text: f(t) = a₀/2 + Σₙ₌₁⁷ Aₙ sin(nω₀ t + φₙ)
Area highlights two full periods of the synthesized signal
